summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its annual general and special meeting scheduled for June 25, 2026, along with related proxy materials. The meeting agenda covers routine items: receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, re-appointing auditors, and re-approving the Omnibus Incentive Plan. No extraordinary corporate event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report required of foreign private issuers, not a special situation. It serves as a meeting reminder and proxy solicitation, with no special structural or financial terms to analyze.
